title: Describing words and -ment adverbs
theme: adjectives for impressions and states; adverbs of manner and frequency
goal: Recognise and use 23 adjectives and adverbs that add colour and precision to what you say.

example.fr: Il fait un temps splendide aujourd'hui.
example.en: The weather is gorgeous today.

example.fr: On a passé une soirée fabuleuse.
example.en: We had a fabulous evening.

example.fr: Ce gâteau au chocolat est divin !
example.en: This chocolate cake is heavenly!

example.fr: Avec lui, c'est l'éternel problème du retard.
example.en: With him, it's the never-ending problem of being late.

example.fr: C'est notre ultime chance de gagner.
example.en: It's our final chance to win.

example.fr: Il est mort dans un accident tragique.
example.en: He died in a tragic accident.

example.fr: Payer 3000 $ pour un sac, c'est insensé !
example.en: Paying $3,000 for a bag is crazy!

example.fr: Il fait une chaleur inhabituelle pour octobre.
example.en: It's unusually hot for October.

items.en: ordinary, nothing special; some … or other

example.fr: C'est un restaurant très quelconque.
example.en: It's a very ordinary restaurant.

example.fr: J'ai trouvé une lettre cachée dans un livre.
example.en: I found a letter hidden in a book.

example.fr: La police cherche une adolescente disparue.
example.en: The police are looking for a missing teenager.

example.fr: Je suis coincé dans le trafic.
example.en: I'm stuck in traffic.

example.fr: J'ai la peau très sèche en hiver.
example.en: My skin is very dry in winter.

example.fr: Évite les aliments trop gras.
example.en: Avoid food that is too fatty.

example.fr: Techniquement, c'est possible, mais c'est cher.
example.en: Technically, it's possible, but it's expensive.

example.fr: Il est sûrement encore au bureau.
example.en: He's probably still at the office.

example.fr: Dernièrement, je dors mal.
example.en: Lately, I haven't been sleeping well.

example.fr: J'étais littéralement mort de fatigue.
example.en: I was literally dead tired.

example.fr: Je suis terriblement désolé.
example.en: I'm terribly sorry.

example.fr: Soudainement, toutes les lumières se sont éteintes.
example.en: Suddenly, all the lights went out.

example.fr: Mon téléphone sonne constamment.
example.en: My phone rings constantly.

example.fr: Ce film est incroyablement long.
example.en: This film is incredibly long.

example.fr: J'ai fait ce gâteau spécialement pour toi.
example.en: I made this cake specially for you.

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body:
- [[Sûrement]] usually means *probably*, not *certainly*.
- [[Constant]] → [[constamment]]: adjectives in -ant/-ent make -amment/-emment.
- [[Quelconque]] after a noun means ordinary: [[un film quelconque]].
- Irregular feminines: [[sec → sèche]], [[gras → grasse]].
- Québec (informal): [[être pogné]] = *être coincé*.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeat each sentence out loud, then record yourself and compare.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Getting something wrong now helps you remember it later.

blocks.prompt: You don't know where Karim is, but it's 4 p.m. on a weekday. What do you say?
What is the feminine of « sec »?
blocks.explain: [[Sec]] has an irregular feminine: [[sèche]], as in [[la peau sèche]].

accept: Je suis coincée dans le trafic.
Je suis coincée dans la circulation.
Je suis coincée dans les bouchons.

blocks.explain: [[Terriblement]] goes before the adjective it strengthens.

blocks.text: J'ai fait ce gâteau ___ pour toi.
blocks.en: I made this cake specially for you.

blocks.text: Mon fils joue ___ aux jeux vidéo. (constant)
blocks.en: My son constantly plays video games.

blocks.fr: Il fait une chaleur inhabituelle pour octobre.
blocks.explain: [[Inhabituelle]] is feminine (une chaleur) so it doubles the l and adds -e.

blocks.fr: Soudainement, toutes les lumières se sont éteintes.
blocks.en: Suddenly, all the lights went out.

summary:
- Give strong impressions: [[splendide, fabuleux, divin, insensé]]
- Describe states: [[caché, disparu, coincé, sec, gras]]
- Use -ment adverbs: [[sûrement, dernièrement, constamment, soudainement]]
